You create, you upload, you get paid. But for digital creators in Kenya, the reality is far more complex. Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted, leaving you stranded without a reliable [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-every-detail-you-3|COREMERCH guide to payment]] gateway. This isn’t just an inconvenience—it’s a barrier to your livelihood. What you need is sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-5|infrastructure]]: a system you own, control, and can depend on, no matter where you are. This isn’t a workaround; it’s a permanent solution built on open tools and crypto payments. Here’s how it works, why it matters, and how you can deploy it today.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-11. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

This is sovereign commerce infrastructure—a complete digital commerce stack designed for creators who cannot rely on traditional payment platforms. It’s not a plugin or a third-party service. It’s a combination of free and paid tools that give you full ownership of your store, payment processing, and product delivery. The core is simple: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. You own the code, the data, and the process. No subscriptions, no platform lock-in, no reliance on services that may reject you. This is infrastructure sovereignty—built for creators who need to operate on their own terms, without permission.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how the pieces fit together. Your beats are hosted on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring fast and reliable delivery. The frontend of your store is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both free and globally distributed. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automates order processing and file delivery. When a buyer pays, NOWPayments verifies the crypto transaction on-chain and triggers a webhook. This webhook fires the delivery script, sending the buyer their beats instantly. Orders are logged in Supabase or Google Sheets, giving you a clear record of sales. The entire system is designed to be lightweight, cost-effective, and fully automated. You don’t need to manage servers or worry about scalability—the infrastructure handles it for you.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other conventional platforms are unavailable or unreliable. If you’re selling beats, ebooks, courses, or templates and need a way to collect payment without depending on third parties, this is for you. It’s also for creators who value ownership and control. With this stack, you’re not renting infrastructure—you’re building on it. You own the code, the data, and the process. There’s no platform that can shut you down, no subscription fees, and no hidden costs. This is for creators who want to operate with confidence, knowing their business is built on a foundation they control.
Own your infrastructure—don’t rent it from platforms that can shut you down.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack is composed of carefully selected tools that work seamlessly together. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, fast hosting for your store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, automating order processing and file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, giving you a clear record of sales. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 hosts your beats, ensuring quick and reliable delivery. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of use. Together, they form a robust commerce stack that gives you full control over your business.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Ready to deploy? Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all six blueprints and seven templates for instant download. Follow the step-by-step guides to set up your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Load your beats into Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and test the delivery process end-to-end. Once deployed, you’ll have a fully operational store that processes payments, delivers products, and logs orders automatically. This isn’t just a solution—it’s a new way to build your business, on your terms.

It includes hosting, backend logic, order storage, and crypto payment processing, all designed to give creators full control over their business. This approach eliminates platform lock-in, subscription fees, and dependency on services that may reject them, providing a reliable and permanent solution for selling digital products.
Crypto payments give you access to a global market, no matter where you are.

It includes all six blueprints and seven templates, giving you everything you need to deploy a fully operational store. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more and take the first step toward infrastructure sovereignty.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free and globally distributed.
2. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing and file delivery.
3. Configure order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets to keep a record of sales.
4. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee.
5. Upload your beats to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for fast and reliable delivery.
6. Test the entire process end-to-end to ensure payments are processed and products are delivered seamlessly.
7. Deploy your store and start selling with full control over your infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes, the Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and templates designed for creators with varying levels of technical expertise. You don’t need to be a developer to deploy this stack.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON.
How much does it cost to deploy this stack?

The Complete Builder Kit is $197 and includes all blueprints and templates. The tools themselves are either free (GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Google Sheets) or have minimal fees (NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction fee).
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?
Yes, the stack is designed to scale with your business. Cloudflare Workers and Supabase can handle increased traffic, and you can add more products or features as needed.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments is a reliable service, but if it goes down, your store will still be operational. Payments will simply be paused until the service is restored. Your data and infrastructure remain under your control.
